sentences.en: An image is formed by the information in the media.
sentences.zh: 媒体中的信息形成了一个形象。

sentences.en: He painted an image he had during meditation last night.
sentences.zh: 他描绘了昨晚冥想时产生的一个印象。

sentences.en: The following images are not for the faint of heart.
sentences.zh: 以下图像可能不适合胆小的人观看。

senses.zh: 像，形象，映象，图像，影像，肖像，想像
